summary_paragraph: The patient, a woman with T1-T2 paraplegia and chronic restrictive lung disease, was readmitted two days after discharge for desaturation to 84% at home. She had ongoing multifocal pneumonia and developed mild pulmonary vascular congestion, likely due to mucus plugging from impaired cough. She was treated with IV vancomycin and piperacillin-tazobactam, bronchodilators, lasix, and aggressive airway clearance using the Flutter Vest and Acapela. Her respiratory status improved, and she was discharged on day two to complete antibiotics at home. A sleep study was recommended for chronic hypercarbia. Discharge included home oxygen, mucolytics, and respiratory equipment delivery.
problems: Chronic airway obstruction, not elsewhere classified
